description: This PHP class defines a set of attribute types for HTML element attributes, providing a mapping from string identifiers to specific attribute definition objects used in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for retrieving and setting attribute types and initializes default types in the constructor.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes
classes.description: Manages a collection of attribute type definitions used for HTML element attributes, with functionalities to retrieve, set, and initialize default attribute types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute types with default implementations for various attribute types, such as Enum, Bool, ID, Length, etc.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute definition object for a given type name, optionally processing type strings with extra information.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces the implementation object for a specified attribute type.
